messages:
Maya (PM): quick thread to lock down the cutover/escape plan for catalog onboarding. customer ops has strong asks after last week's surprise swap.
Oliver (Eng): high level: customers can pin to a model spec, we support pin_ttl and an emergency rollback API. question is how visible we make the lifecycle states.
Jess (DevEx): field note: customers want machine-readable lifecycle state in every model metadata payload (not just console). helps automation.
Sam (CS): also asking for SLA: 'we need a guaranteed rollback ability within 4 hours of reporting' and a documented runbook. legal wants the comm window logged.
Oliver (Eng): runtime plan: introduce states: ACTIVE, PINNED, PENDING_DEPRECATION, DEPRECATED. PENDING_DEPRECATION prevents auto-upgrades and surfaces flags. rollback flow is: switch route -> canary (20%) for 15m -> if metrics ok, ramp.
Oliver (Eng): example API patch (sketch): ```json
{ "model_id": "redwood/longchat-v2", "lifecycle": "PENDING_DEPRECATION", "pin_ttl_days": 45, "rollback_window_hours": 4 }
```
Jess (DevEx): we'll include `lifecycle` in the /models and /inference responses as structured JSON: `model_metadata.lifecycle`. console shows banner + toast for affected tenants.
Maya (PM): rollout gates idea: (1) perf parity within 3% latency and top-level quality metric within +/-2 pts, (2) infra canary holds under load, (3) customer dry-run completed and signed off.
qa-bot: Perf tests queued for canary: catalog/longchat-v2 -> baseline vs candidate. ETA 6h.
Sam (CS): for pilots we need onboarding checklist: contact points, expected metric thresholds, rollback contacts, and a scheduled dry-run date. I'll draft and share.
Jess (DevEx): also recommend adding a `pending_deprecation_reason` field for auditability. customers want a short human string for emails.
Oliver (Eng): telemetry: need regression detectors (embedding drift, top-k accuracy, latency spikes). suggest automated alerts that recommend rollback but don't auto-execute unless an enterprise emergency flag is set.
Maya (PM): policy question: do we allow customer-triggered immediate rollback (yes) vs platform-triggered rollback (opt-in per customer)?
Sam (CS): customers will want the ability to opt into automatic rollback on quality regressions. but many will choose manual. we should make opt-in explicit during onboarding.
Oliver (Eng): implementation tasks: API addition (lifecycle + metadata) -> DevEx work for responses -> routing + canary orchestration -> telemetry hooks -> runbook updates. estimate: 4 sprints to beta if we parallelize.
Maya (PM): owners: Oliver (eng runtime + telemetry), Jess (DevEx API + console), Sam (pilot coordination + runbook). Target: gated beta with 3 pilot tenants in 6 weeks.
release-bot: Created draft canary for redwood/longchat-v2 on dedicated-pool-7 :rocket:
Maya (PM): next steps: Jess drafts API doc and sample responses by Thu, Oliver opens PR for lifecycle fields and canary docs by Wed, Sam to confirm two pilots by EOD tomorrow. follow-up sync Friday.
Jess (DevEx): ack, will include example curl responses + library snippets.
Oliver (Eng): ack, will include telemetry spec and alert thresholds in PR.
Sam (CS): pinging pilot customers now. will update channel.
Maya (PM): thanks. if anyone hits blockers call it out earlier. end. :thumbsup:
